notes.text: HTTP clients make REST calls to CHAT (FastAPI); web (Next.js 14) makes REST calls to INTERACTION (Flask).

CHAT (FastAPI) and INTERACTION (Flask) read + write PostgreSQL and enqueue SQS tasks; CHAT (FastAPI) also makes API calls to LLM providers; INTERACTION (Flask) also starts Temporal workflows and makes API calls to CRM + workspace APIs.
